title: formvis

toolchain.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf libxdo-dev libssl-dev zsync

setup.linux:
case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) appimage=amd64 ;; *) appimage=aarch64 ;; esac
echo "LDAI_UPDATE_INFORMATION=$(python3 setup/package_desktop.py zsync-info --appimage "$appimage")" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

post_build.macos:
rd="$FORMCOMPILER_RELEASE_DIR"
python3 setup/package_desktop.py mac-archive --arch "$FORMCOMPILER_ARCH" --release-dir "$rd"
if [ -n "$APPLE_ID" ] && [ -n "$APPLE_PASSWORD" ] && [ -n "$APPLE_TEAM_ID" ]; then python3 setup/package_desktop.py notarize --release-dir "$rd"; fi
pa="$FORMCOMPILER_ARCH"
if [ "$pa" = x64 ]; then pa=x86_64; fi
python3 setup/package_desktop.py portable-macos --arch "$pa" --release-dir "$rd"

extras.name: linux-riscv64
extras.run:
npm ci --prefix frontend
npm run build --prefix frontend
python3 setup/package_desktop.py riscv64

assets:
python3 setup/package_desktop.py feed --tag "$FORMCOMPILER_TAG" --base-url "https://github.com/$FORMCOMPILER_REPOSITORY/releases/download/$FORMCOMPILER_TAG/" --dir "$DIST"
python3 setup/release_notes.py "v$FORMCOMPILER_VERSION" --out release-notes.md
python3 setup/mcpb.py --out "$DIST"
python3 setup/package_desktop.py sums --dir "$DIST"

catalog.name: FormVis
catalog.summary: Layered image editing: layers, masks, selections, painting and export.

notes_for_owner: macos-universal, windows-x86 and windows-arm64 are not built: numpy, onnxruntime, opencv-python-headless, Pillow, pillow-heif, rawpy and psd-tools publish no universal2 wheels, onnxruntime, rawpy, pillow-heif, OpenEXR and psd-tools no 32-bit Windows wheels, and opencv-python-headless no Windows ARM64 wheel at the pinned versions (checked on PyPI 2026-10-30), so PyInstaller cannot freeze the engine there. Intel Macs use macos-x64 and Windows on ARM runs the x64 build. The msix step needs the MSIX_IDENTITY_NAME, MSIX_PUBLISHER and MSIX_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME variables in formcompiler and skips itself without them. FORMVIS_FREEZE_ML stays unset (the old default, 0). Both formvis's own latest.json and SHA256SUMS (from assets) and formcompiler's latest.json and SHA256SUMS.txt are written; formcompiler's latest.json replaces formvis's when the updater key is set, and it also covers darwin-x86_64, whose archive is named formvis_x64.app.tar.gz.
